title: Why do you want this job? Wrong answers Only!
description:
Hi Job Seekers!

Interviews are stressful, and the job market is competitive, but sometimes laughter is the best stress relief. This Short is just for fun: “Why do you want this job?” wrong answers only! 

I’m not making light of your job search, and for real, actionable advice, check out my channel  @kirchnercareers where I share weekly tips on resumes, cover letters, interview questions, and job search strategies to help you stand out and land your dream role. I am sending you all of the offer letter vibes!

transcript: Can you tell us why you're interested in this role? Well, there's this thing I like to do called eating. [music] You should really try it sometime. I would like to be able to do that more than like three times a week.
